item.title: New Class! AI for the Rest of Us - Using (and Refusing)
item.author: worldwide@worldwidestew.com (Michael Davis)
item.description: A live, online workshop for people who are curious about AI — but have legitimate concerns about using it safely and selectively. 📅 October 17, 2026 | 9:00–10:30 AM Central Time 💻 Online via Zoom | Small group, max 25 participants 💲 $75 per person You’ve heard the alarming news. Now what? AI isn’t one-size-fits-all. Recent months have brought real, well-documented cases of AI systems acting in unexpected — even unauthorized — ways.
